description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Publix Super Markets, Inc. is hiring an Associate Software Engineer for its Finance Systems team. The role develops, tests, and supports software solutions for vendor funding and accounting processes, contributing to application modernization and automation.
Associate Software Engineer developing and supporting Finance Systems applications, APIs, and integrations for vendor funding and accounting processes

Responsibilities:
• Develop and support software solutions that enable critical vendor funding and accounting processes across Publix
• Collaborate with software engineers, business analysts, quality engineers, and product owners to deliver high-quality technology solutions
• Participate in the design, development, testing, and deployment of new features and enhancements for Finance Systems applications
• Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established development standards and best practices
• Troubleshoot application issues, investigate defects, and assist with production support activities
• Develop and consume APIs, services, and data integrations that support enterprise business processes
• Participate in code reviews and team discussions to improve solution quality and expand technical knowledge
• Contribute to automated testing efforts and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices
• Learn and apply modern technologies, development tools, and AI-assisted engineering capabilities to improve productivity and solution quality
• Gain knowledge of financial and accounting business processes while helping modernize legacy applications and workflows

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related analytical field or equivalent experience
• Basic understanding of software development concepts and system architectures

Preferred:
• 1+ years of professional software engineering experience
• Familiarity with .NET Core or .NET Framework
• Familiarity with SQL Server, including writing queries
• Experience leveraging AI-powered development workflows to improve productivity, quality, and delivery speed

Skills:
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related analytical field or equivalent experience
• Basic understanding of software development concepts and system architectures
• 1+ years of professional software engineering experience
• Familiarity with .NET Core or .NET Framework
• Familiarity with SQL Server, including writing queries
• Experience leveraging AI-powered development workflows to improve productivity, quality, and delivery speed

Pay: $5,890/mo - $8,835/mo
